entries.org: hwatu -- Browser Engine for AI Coding Agents
bullets: Built a daemon-based WebKit browser in Rust (WebKitGTK 6) that makes visual verification nearly free for coding agents: 13 ms median window spawn (p90 35 ms) from a warm daemon, 216 ms full verify loop
Designed the agent-facing control plane: JSON-over-Unix-socket IPC protocol, MCP server over stdio, headless-as-window-property rendering, and human hand-off into a tiling window manager
Sole author across a 3-crate Rust workspace (client, daemon, IPC); 350+ commits with published engineering writeups and benchmarks

Composed a development environment where AI agents are first-class citizens: custom browser (hwatu), agent memory servers (MCP), and Wayland compositor tooling orchestrated for autonomous verify-fix loops
Built and deployed multiple MCP servers (game-economy analytics API wrapper, personal relationship memory) used daily by local and remote agents

Designed plan-approve-execute UX for an autonomous freight-exception agent on Cloudflare Workers (Subconscious reasoning, Baseten vision/ASR); live SSE trace surfaces draft carrier, customer, and AR messages
Architected repo partitions (web / worker / db) and built full Next.js storefront with voice-first mic launcher in a 2-hour build sprint
Built Next.js 16 coach dashboard for ACL-injury triage: 60+ athlete rosters, body-silhouette injury mapping, structured check-in flow, and role-based routing
Integrated FastAPI backend running MediaPipe pose extraction and RAG-grounded rehab retrieval to turn short video + text intake into severity and urgency bands
Own the end-to-end frontend of an AI product as one of the first engineers: prototyping features and shipping polished, production-ready interfaces
Built and maintain the full marketing site and interactive product demos used in investor and customer-facing presentations
Defined the company's visual identity and design system; responsible for all brand, motion, and interaction decisions
Led a squad in a top-ranked infantry platoon (1st of 48) in CQB room-clearing competition
Automated high-stakes administrative reporting with Excel macro pipelines, minimizing errors across the battalion
Developed a server-side rendered digital exhibition platform with Next.js, improving accessibility and SEO
Collaborated with MIT History faculty to launch a digital archive of activist murals, increasing visibility to 1,000+ users
